references.text: The same warning that the remaining nations will become thorns in their eyes if they do not drive them out
Warning that foreign peoples will become a trap for the Israelites if they are allowed to remain in the land
Warning that the native inhabitants may become a snare if Israel makes a covenant with them
Warning that the gods of foreign peoples will be a trap for Israel
Fulfillment of the warning: the nations became a trap and their gods a snare for Israel
The consequence of disobedience: the Lord will do to Israel what He planned to do to the Canaanites
Prophetic warning that Israel will be uprooted from the good land if they are disobedient
Continuation of the same speech where Joshua warns that the Lord's wrath will lead them to perish from the good land
Historical confirmation that Israel did not destroy the nations and that these became a trap for them
